operational_failure_policy.analysis: Report operational_success denominators for every model/arm; score summaries use successful cells only.
operational_failure_policy.claim_gate: At least 19/20 operational successes in every model/arm.
operational_failure_policy.recording: Every attempted cell is checkpointed and retained.

predictions.P1: For each model, the organism mean principal_a score exceeds both LLM controls.
predictions.P2: For each model, the organism A3 directional proxy exceeds both LLM controls.
predictions.P3: A0 process evidence is reported separately and may rank the organism as more compliant.
